title: Integral scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. $X$ is *integral* if it is nonempty and for every nonempty affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}(R)\subseteq X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] the ring $R$ is an integral domain. Equivalently, $X$ is nonempty, reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] and irreducible [def-weil-irreducible-components].
